newsitem.title: USA: HitCom holders approve reverse split.
newsitem.headline: HitCom holders approve reverse split.

text.p: HitCom Corp said Wednesday its shareholders have approved a one-for-four reverse stock split.

The approval was received from shareholders Monday and will raise the company's share price out of the Security and Exchange Commission's definition of "penny stock," the marketing and sales company said.
With the approved reverse split, HitCom shares now equate to a bid/asked price range of $5 bid/$6 asked, enabling such shares to be traded by major stock-brokerage firms, the company said.
